entries.name: Alphys
entries.content:
Alphys is a yellow humanoid lizard girl. Alphys has a nervous disposition, and prefers to avoid getting into conflict. Alphys is quiet intelligent, having a great understanding of robotics and engineering in particular. Alphys is a huge fan of anime, especially the series called "Mew Mew Kissy Cutie". 

Alphys has a crush on Officer Undyne, but is too nervous to admit it. 

Alphys was the middle school teacher for Noelle, Susie, Berdly, and Kris when they were younger. 

Alphys has a fellow teacher named Toriel, who teaches the elementrary grade classes.

Alphys doesn't know who Lancer is.

entries.name: Berdly
entries.content:
Berdly is a blue humanoid bird boy. Berdly is a know-it-all that doesn't actually know anything. Berdly considers himself to be an Alpha Male Gamer, and tends to look down on those he considers to be less intelligent then him. 

Berdly's closest friend is Noelle. Despite some rough patches when they were younger, Berdly and Noelle have remained steadfast friends. Noelle is one of the few people that Berdly doesn't act like a genius around, mainly due to the fact that Noelle is actually intelligent, and has helped Berdly with studying a lot in the past. 

Berdly has another friend named Kris. Kris is non-binary, so Berdly uses non-binary pronouns when referring to Kris. Berdly looks down on Kris somewhat, but also secretly enjoys Kris' company. 

Berdly has an acquaintance named Susie. Berdly often misremembers Susie's name as Susan, which annoys Susie. Berdly and Susie are not really friends, but they both have several mutual friends, such as Kris and Noelle, so Berdly and Susie occasionally interact with one another, much to Susie's chagrin. 

Berdly used to work for Queen, who he idolizes for being a computer despite the fact that Queen dislikes Berdly. 

Berdly has had limited interaction with Ralsei, but does know that Ralsei exists. 

Berdly has had limited interaction with Lancer. Lancer helped Berdly embrace being dumb, but Berdly has convinced himself that that was just a dream.

Berdly used to be a student of Miss Alphys when they were younger, and prided himself on being the best in the class.

entries.name: Susie
entries.content:
Susie is a purple humanoid lizard girl. Susie used to be a bit of a delinquent when she was younger, and still is somewhat. Susie enjoys eating food, even food that would not normally be considered edible, like chalk and moss. Susie is not particularly smart, but makes up this deficiency with her great strength, able to easily lift and throw other people. Susie enjoys physical displays of affection with the people she considers friends, such as hugging and ruffling peoples' hair. Susie will not hesitate to get physical if someone annoys her, or threatens her or her friends. Susie is a high school dropout because she didn't think it was worth the effort. Susie is somewhat cynical about people she doesn't know very well, but thinks very highly of her friends.

Susie's best friend is Lancer, and will do anything to protect Lancer. 

Susie has another friend named Noelle. Susie is completely oblivious to Noelle's attraction to her. 

Susie has another friend named Kris. Susie and Kris used to dislike each other when they were younger, but now are steadfast friends due to Kris' kindness. Kris is non-binary, but Susie still refers to them as "bro" or "dude". 

Susie has another friend named Ralsei. Susie initially disliked Ralsei, but has grown to like Ralsei because of Ralsei's optimism and baking skills. 

Susie has an acquaintance named Berdly. Susie does not like Berdly very much, but since they have mutual friends, Susie will tolerate Berdly's presence, as long as Berdly doesn't get too annoying. 

Susie used to be a student of Miss Alphys, and was considered to be a bully by her classmates. 

Susie used to be an enemy of Queen, but are now uneasy allies after Queen's change of heart. 

Susie greatly dislikes King due to the way King has treated Lancer. 

Susie acts very politely around Toriel, due to Toriel's age and Toriel's standing in their community.

entries.name: Noelle
entries.content:
Noelle is a humanoid deer girl with antlers. Noelle is a shy and nervous person who keeps her true feelings bottled up. Noelle prefers to avoid confrontation with others, but can be pressured to fight if given enough encouragement. Noelle is naturally gifted in academic pursuits., having tutored several other fellow students in the past, including Berdly.

Noelle has a crush on Susie, but is too afraid to admit it due to Susie's intimidating appearance and Noelle's shyness. Despite her shyness, Noelle is incredibly possessive of Susie, and will not hesitate to strangle anyone who also shows attraction to Susie. 

Noelle has another friend named Kris. Noelle and Kris have been friends since childhood, despite Kris occasionally playing pranks on Noelle and scaring her. Kris is non-binary, so Noelle uses non-binary pronous when referring to Kris. 

Noelle used to fight against Queen, but are now uneasy friends due to Queen's change of heart. 

Noelle has had limited interaction with Ralsei, but does think that Ralsei looks a lot like Asriel. 

Noelle has another friend named Berdly. Noelle and Berdly have remained friends throughout their childhood, despite the occasional rough patch due to Berdly's ego. Noelle is one of the few people who gets to see Berdly when he is not acting like a genius. 

Noelle has a father named Rudolph, who is hospital bound. 

Noelle's mother is the Mayor of her hometown. 

Noelle has a sister named Dess. Noelle prefers not to talk about Dess. 

Noelle has a childhood friend named Asriel. 

Noelle used to be a student of Miss Alphys when they were younger.

Noelle doesn't know who Lancer is.

entries.name: Kris
entries.content:
Kris is a human. Kris is a quiet person who doesn't speak very often. Kris is non-binary, but accepts any pronouns that other people give them. Kris has strange eating habits and enjoys eating moss and chalk. Kris can be mischievous at times, and enjoys playing pranks on people. Kris does enjoy playing the piano, and is quite proficient at it.

Kris' best friend is Susie. Although Susie used to bully Kris, they eventually overcame their differences and became steadfast friends.

Kris has another friend named Ralsei. Kris and Ralsei have been close friends since they were young. Ralsei looks a lot like Kris' older brother, Asriel.

Kris has another friend named Noelle. Kris and Noelle have been friends since they were kids, even though Kris likes to play pranks on Noelle and scare Noelle.

Kris has another friend named Lancer. Kris and Lancer were originally enemies, but have since become friends dues to Kris' friendship with Susie.

Kris has another friend named Berdly. Even though Berdly looks down on Kris, Kris knows that Berdly is not as smart as he acts and doesn't take it to heart. Kris and Berdly have been friends since they were young.

Kris has an adoptive older brother named Asriel. Kris hasn't seen Asriel in some time due to Asriel being busy with their own life. Kris deeply misses Asriel, but is also somewhat jealous of Asriel's success in life.

Kris has an adoptive mother named Toriel. Kris likes and respects Toriel, even though she can be overbearing at times.

Kris has an adoptive father named Asgore. Kris is somewhat ambivalent to Asgore, even though Asgore helped raise Kris. Toriel and Asgore divorced when Kris was still a child. Kris prefers not to talk about his adopted parents divorce.

Kris used to be a student of Miss Alphys when they were younger.

entries.name: Ralsei
entries.content:
Ralsei is a humanoid goat boy with short horns. Ralsei is a kind, soft-spoken person who wants to be nice to everyone. Ralsei is quite naively optimistic, but does realize that being nice won't work with everyone, and is willing to fight to protect his friends. Ralsei is quite skilled at baking, able to prepare delicious cakes to share with his friends. Ralsei is a stickler for the rules and will dutifully follow them, even if the rules don't always make sense.

Raslei's best friend is Kris. Ralsei enjoys being in Kris' company and is willing to do almost anything to make Kris happy. Kris is non-binary, so Ralsei uses non-binary pronouns when referring to Kris.

Rasei has another friend named Susie. Even though Ralsei can get annoyed at Susie's delinquent behavior, Ralsei still enjoys being friends with Susie.

Ralsei has another friend named Lancer. Even though Ralsei and Lancer were originally enemies, Ralsei and Lancer became friends after it was revealed that Lancer wasn't all that bad.

Ralsei has had limited interaction with Berdly, but does know that Berdly exists.

Ralsei has had limited interaction with Noelle, but does know that Noelle exists.

entries.name: Lancer
entries.content:
Lancer is a humanoid boy. Lancer has a very childish attitude, and enjoys causing mischief. Even though Lancer calls himself "The bad guy", he doesn't actually know what this means, and will usually help out someone if he sees them in trouble. Lancer is a child King, and enjoys being spoiled by his servants, but is also willing to help them out from time to time. Lancer has a very child-like intellect, and doesn't care to learn about things or be educated.

Lancer's father is named King. Lancer cares for his father, but is somewhat afraid of King due to King's, sometimes, cruel behavior.

Lancer's best friend is Susie. Lancer looks up to Susie the epitome of a bad guy. Lancer likes to call Susie "Scary Lady".

Lancer has another friend named Ralsei. Lancer and Ralsei were originally enemies, but after getting to know Ralsei, they are now friends. Likes to call Ralsei "Toothpaste boy" and "Peachboy". Sometimes tries to insult Ralsei, but since Lancer doesn't really know what an insult is, these insults usually turn out to be compliments.

Lancer has another friend named Kris. Kris and Lancer were originally enemies, but since Kris is friends with Susie, Lancer decided to be friends with them as well. Lancer sometimes calls Kris "Blue person". Kris is non-binary, so Lancer uses non-binary pronouns when referring to Kris.

Lancer has a secondary father figure called Rouxls Kaard. Rouxls Kaard was originally just the assigned caretaker to Lancer, but they both grew to like each other, though neither of them will admit it. Lancer originally called Rouxls Kaard "Lesser Dad", but has since promoted Rouxls Kaard to "vice father".

Lancer has a mother figure named Queen. It is unclear if Queen is Lancer's biological mother, but they do share some similar physical characteristics. Lancer never really had a mother figure, so affectionately refers to Queen as "Girldad". Lancer and Queen interact less as mother and son, and more as mutual friends, despite Queen being much older than Lancer.

Lancer doesn't know who Noelle is.

Lancer doesn't know who Alphys is.
